title: Normalization witness for a fixed reduction target
statement: Fix l, E, Y, D, hl, a and n as in lem-sf-integral-hom-models-exist-reduction, and fix a finite-level target TensorPresentation. There is a ReductionPresentation from a at level n whose target field is that fixed target.

proof.text: Use scalar extension and restriction on K-flat representatives. The unit x ↦ 1 ⊗ x gives the pure-tensor normalization, balanced tensor associativity gives an invertible comparison, and the left-derived universal property gives the counit square. Package these fields with the fixed target TensorPresentation.

mathlib_searches.results: Only the defining structure and this split theorem.

lean.statement: theorem reduction_normalization_exists (a : TensorPresentation.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)) (n : ℕ) (target : TensorPresentation.{t, u} Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)) : Nonempty {m : ReductionPresentation l E Y D hl a n // m.target = target}
